sessions.name: Network Effects and Economies of Scale
sessions.description:
• Gain economic frameworks to understand and manage network businesses
  • Understand cost/benefit aspects of platform-based network businesses
  • Identify strategic considerations for two-sided and multi-sided platform businesses
sessions.summary: This lecture covers some of the most fundamental principles behind what makes digital platforms powerful business models. Aside from the economic forces of Network effects and economies of scale, we will cover the workings of two- and multi-sided platforms, the challenge of single- vs. multi-homing, and the role of switching costs in customer retention.

sessions.name: Designing Digital Platforms
sessions.description:
• Identify the building blocks of designing platform marketplaces
  • Grasp frameworks for pricing strategies and the workings of online auctions
  • Understand the role of big data as a strategic asset in platform marketplaces
sessions.summary: This lecture describes the main components of a variety of digital platform business models. In addition to spelling out the economic forces behind the most common business models, we will explore key components to revenue generation that include pricing, product versioning, marketplace fees, auctions and their role in the digital economy, and how big-Data can become an important strategic asset
